title: A082935 — Wilson first-round digit-sum conjecture + exact formula (Lean 4)
description: theorem A082935_wilson_conjecture: for every n >= 1, n != 19, the first-round digit sum of a082935 n equals n; for n = 19 the first-round sum is 199 and the second-round sum is 19. Proves the conjecture stated by Robert G. Wilson v on the OEIS entry (checked by him to n = 100, open since 2003) via the exact formula (theorem A082935_formula): a(n) = n for n <= 9; a(19) = 1949999999999999999999491; for n >= 10, n != 19, a(n) = concat(n, mu(n - 2*sigma(n)), rev(n)) where mu(t) is the Nat.ofDigits-smallest palindromic digit-string of digit sum t. Corollary A082217_characterization: a082217 n = 0 iff n = 19, and a082217 n = a082935 n otherwise — the 'only zero' comment on A082217 was asserted without proof. Lean 4 + mathlib v4.35.0, kernel-pure: zero sorry, zero native_decide, axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] on all five top theorems. Blind oracle transcription audit archived in VERIFICATIONS/. Direction check only: exact formula reproduces the Irvine b-file on all 175 terms.
